verses.1: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken to you, children of Israel, regarding all the families that I brought out of the land of Egypt, as it is written:
verses.2: I only know about you from among all the families of the land. Therefore, I will bring upon you all your troubles.
verses.3: They should go together, not separately.
verses.4: The lion will roar in the forest, but he won’t be able to catch anything. His roar will go unheard, as no one will listen to him.
verses.5: The locusts cover the surface of the earth; there’s no way for them to get off the ground. They can’t move anywhere.
verses.6: If a plague is spread throughout the city, and the people do not panic, then it means that there is no evil in the city. Jehovah has not done this.
verses.7: For the Lord God will not do anything unless He gives a sign to His servants, the prophets.
verses.8: Ar’e Shaag: Who does not fear the Lord Jehovah? Who does not obey His words?
verses.9: Speak to us about the towers in Ashdod, and also about the towers in the land of Egypt. Say that they were gathered together on Mount Sinai. See how many dead bodies there were inside those towers, and how many people died there.
verses.10: And they would not know what to do when Jehovah’s anger was poured out upon their cities.
verses.11: Therefore, thus said Adonai YHWH: “The land will be desolate around you, and your strength will be taken away from you. Your towers will be destroyed.”
verses.12: Thus said Jehovah: When the righteous are rescued from the hands of their enemies, or in times of great distress, then the children of Israel who dwell in Shechem will also be saved.
verses.13: Hear and testify in the house of Jacob. Let Adonai Yahweh, the God of the tribes, speak.
verses.14: For on the day when I punished the sins of Israel, I also punished their idols. The rays of light from those idols were destroyed, and they fell to the ground.
verses.15: And I destroyed the house of destruction over the house of the cherubim. And they were destroyed in the houses of the serpents. And many houses were also destroyed, says the LORD.
